paxnet_err_version: Your network version differs from the host's.
paxnet_err_version_do: Update the game to the host's version and join again.
paxnet_err_app_version: The version of the mod you play with differs from the host's.
paxnet_err_app_version_do: Install the same version of the mod as the host and join again.
paxnet_err_mods: Your mods differ from the host's.
paxnet_err_mods_do: Enable the same mods as the host and join again.
paxnet_err_full: No free seats in this game.
paxnet_err_full_do: Ask the host to free a seat.
paxnet_err_code: No such code, or the invite is outdated.
paxnet_err_code_do: Check the code with your friend or ask for a new invite.
paxnet_err_banned: The host closed entry for you.
paxnet_err_started: The game is running and the host's rules close entry.
paxnet_err_started_do: Ask the host to allow joining a running game.
paxnet_err_seat_taken: Another player already leads this country.
paxnet_err_seat_taken_do: Pick another country or become a co-ruler.
paxnet_err_timeout: No word from the host for a while: the connection is lost.
paxnet_err_timeout_do: The game is already trying to come back. You can press «Join again»: you return to your country.
paxnet_err_kicked: The host removed you from the game.
paxnet_err_host_left_do: Wait until the host starts it again and join with the same code.
paxnet_err_illegal: Order rejected: that is not allowed.
paxnet_err_illegal_do: Read the reason in the order window and fix the order.
paxnet_err_host_only: In this game the host moves time.
paxnet_err_host_only_do: Ask the host to pause or change speed.
paxnet_err_rate: Too many commands in a row.
paxnet_err_bad_packet_do: If it happens again, join again.
paxnet_err_desync: Your world diverged from the host's and did not repair itself.
paxnet_err_desync_do: Press «Join again» — the world arrives in a few seconds.
paxnet_err_pin: The host's key does not match your invite: someone may be intercepting the connection, or the invite is from an old game.
paxnet_err_pin_do: Do not join. Ask the host for a fresh invite over a channel you trust.
paxnet_err_no_route_do: Press «Join again»: the game enters the room through the relay once more.
paxnet_err_relay: The Pax Universe relay is unavailable.
paxnet_err_relay_do: Check your internet and the game version, then try again in a minute.
